item.title: 2007 Toyota FJ Cruiser at No Reserve
item.description: This 2007 Toyota FJ Cruiser has been registered in California since 2013 and has 159k miles. Finished in Titanium Metallic over Dark Charcoal cloth, it is powered by a 4.0-liter 1GR-FE V6 linked to a five-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a locking rear differential. Equipment includes 17" alloy wheels, A-TRAC traction control, a roof rack, a receiver hitch, a six-disc CD stereo, cruise control, and air conditioning. item.description: This 1971 Dodge Challenger coupe is powered by a 318ci V8 paired with a three-speed automatic transmission, and it is finished in Gold Metallic over Chestnut vinyl. The seller purchased the car out of an Arizona estate in June 2024, and subsequent work is said to have involved replacing the timing chain and the fuel pump as well as overhauling the cooling, braking, and suspension systems. item.description: This 1990 Volkswagen Golf GTI G60 is a German-market example that was acquired by the seller in 2023 and subsequently imported to the US, and it now shows 161k kilometers (~100k miles). item.description: This 1987 Chevrolet Corvette coupe spent time with a single owner in North Dakota before being acquired by the seller in 2025, and it now has 29k miles. Subsequent work consisted of repairing the driver seat bolster, repainting the front bumper cover, replacing the exhaust system, and replacing the battery.
